symptom: A valid dated all-country vacation search presents the ordinary catalog count and cards until the user enables the online-booking filter.
expected_behavior: Valid dates automatically activate availability filtering; online-only may further refine the confirmed available set but must not enable availability itself.
environment: Public VII release 556 at https://vii.spaplus.co on 2026-10-21, future stay 2026-11-10 through 2026-11-12, two guests.

steps: Open the public all-country vacation search with from, till and guests.
Wait for the live supplier request to settle with online-only off.
Compare the visible result count with the live-search API response.
Enable online-only and observe that the result set then narrows.
reproduction.evidence: The public heading showed 573 places while the matching supplier response contained 56 available, 30 unavailable and 253 unknown records; the quick filter was aria-pressed=false.

observations.observation: The search page invokes live supplier search whenever valid dates exist.
The main filter applies matchesOnline only when onlineOnly is true, while dated availability otherwise affects ordering rather than eligibility.
Event dated search also ranks supplier availability but does not exclude unavailable or unknown venues from its main filtered set.
observations.evidence: app/events/search/page.tsx filtered memo and supplier rank logic.

hypotheses.mechanism: Dated eligibility is incorrectly coupled to the online-only filter, so the live response changes card labels and rank but not result membership.
hypotheses.prediction: With dates and online-only off, result count remains near the full catalog even though the supplier returns unavailable and unknown records; enabling online-only reduces the set.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare public count and card states with the exact live-search response before and after online-only.
hypotheses.result: Supported by direct public reproduction and source inspection.

hypotheses.mechanism: The date parameters are not parsed or sent to the supplier at all.
hypotheses.prediction: The search header would not restore the selected dates and no matching supplier request or dated card status would appear.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the public search header, supplier endpoint and search hook state for the exact URL.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: selected dates were restored and the endpoint returned a keyed dated response.

hypotheses.mechanism: Only the all-country geography alias causes the full catalog result.
hypotheses.prediction: Regional dated searches would filter unavailable records correctly with online-only off.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect shared eligibility code and run regional dated cases.
hypotheses.result: Source inspection rejects geography as the primary mechanism because availability filtering is absent before geography is applied; regional runtime verification remains part of the repair suite.

fix.change: Dated eligibility is now independent of online-only. Vacation and event list, count, map and nearby recovery require an exact positive supplier result; spa fails closed when its requested date is not covered or the provider check fails. Explicit discovery calls receive a short keyed last-good cache while detail and booking remain realtime.
fix.evidence: The production build, TypeScript check, 17 regression guard groups, 1,433 project tests with the one discovered localization failure corrected and rechecked, and the focused 25-test dated-search suite pass. Public verification remains required on the frozen release.

affected_family: Shared date state and async failure handling
regression_checks: Event unknown, unavailable and zero-price exclusion
Spa uncovered-date and provider-failure fail-closed states
List, count, map and nearby result-set parity
Online-only remains a refinement of dated eligibility
Date labels restore in vacation, event and spa search
Retry, stale and empty states are localized in Hebrew, English, Russian and French
Discovery cache key includes world, dates, party and room or event slot
Booking and detail flows do not opt into discovery cache
remaining_unknowns: The exact production UI and provider counts must be re-observed after publishing the frozen candidate; the local Vinext runtime cannot reproduce production database bindings.
authorization_boundary: Diagnose, repair, test and publish one production release; do not create bookings, mutate supplier data, change DNS or invent unsupported availability.
